stem: The dot plot shows the number of passengers in each of 14 cars that passed a highway checkpoint during one hour. What is the mode of the data?
solution: The mode is the value that occurs most often.
The value 1 has 5 dots, more than any other value, so the mode is 1.

explanation.A: Correct. The value 1 appears 5 times, more than any other value.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the median: with 14 values, the 7th and 8th values are both 2. The mode is the most frequent value.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the range, \(5 - 1 = 4\), not the mode.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the greatest value in the data, not the value that occurs most often.

verify:
v = figure['values']
assert len(v) == 14
mode = max(set(v), key=v.count)
assert v.count(mode) > max(v.count(u) for u in set(v) if u != mode)
assert mode == 1
assert value(choices[answer]) == mode
assert all(value(choices[k]) != mode for k in choices if k != answer)
